n2.text: What changed: no landing screen, no section switching, no Latin motto, no serif display face, no manual input boxes in public. One sans (IBM Plex) plus mono for numbers. Holdings before the monitor. Energy, borrowing rates and yield sparklines fold into a 'More' row. Languages become one line under Currently. Vita becomes four CV lines.
